g.text: 1. POST /api/platform → PlatformService → PostgreSQL → HTTP POST sync → CommandService → RabbitMQ async publish → CommandService subscriber
2. CommandService startup → gRPC GetAllPlatforms → PlatformService:666 → seed local InMemory DB (with retry 5x)
3. External: acme.com → NGINX Ingress → ClusterIP (platforms-srv / commands-srv) → Services
